policy.low_confidence: When all gate-kept visual history evidence is below the calibrated reference score, clear similar_good/similar_risk and show a no reliable history message.
policy.llm_injection: Low-confidence visual history is not injected into Value Master LLM rules as concrete evidence.
policy.page_copy: Show 暂无可靠历史相似图 and the score context to operations users.

scope: Evidence display and LLM context only; value grade model remains v0.7.39-legacy.
limitations: 0.1208 is a small-sample calibration hint, not a final production hard threshold.
The policy should be recalibrated after more human TopK labels are collected.
It does not prove visual similarity quality; it reduces misleading evidence exposure.
